settings.auth_mode.label: Authentication mode
settings.auth_mode.description: Choose between automatic local CLI token or dashboard password.
settings.cli_token_path.label: CLI secrets directory
settings.cli_token_path.description: Path to folder containing machine-id and auth/cli-secret (default ~/.9router).
settings.dashboard_password.label: Dashboard password
settings.dashboard_password.description: Password used to authenticate with 9Router dashboard.
settings.dashboard_host.label: Dashboard host
settings.dashboard_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the 9Router server (e.g. localhost, 127.0.0.1).
settings.dashboard_port.label: Dashboard port
settings.base_url.label: Base URL
settings.base_url.description: Full base URL of the 9Router server.
settings.refresh_seconds.label: Heartbeat refresh interval (s)
settings.refresh_seconds.description: How often to poll for status updates if the stream disconnects.
settings.show_model_label.label: Show model name in bar
settings.show_model_label.description: Show model text in the bar pill. If off, only shows the status glyph.
settings.remember_password.label: Remember dashboard password
settings.remember_password.description: Store dashboard password in login keyring for automatic re-login.
settings.busy_hold_seconds.label: Active hold duration (s)
settings.busy_hold_seconds.description: How long to keep the active glow after a request finishes.
